comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for GenLoss (3-knob). build.py reads THIS file. Drive and mix are baked; dropouts deferred. Hiss is now a knob.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_. Grouped under DLY (fewest stock effects = easy to find).

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade. GenLoss previously had NO level or mix control at all -- its last knob was Hiss, a noise amount -- so it was the one effect you could not sit against the dry signal.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
